bug_locations: dependency_order function - nodes collection (missing referenced nodes)
dependency_order function - incoming dict construction (missing referenced nodes)
dependency_order function - ready membership check (using set for O(1) tracking)
dependency_order function - cycle detection (missing ValueError raise)
explanation: Four bugs: (1) `nodes` only included dict keys, missing nodes that appear only as dependency values — fixed by also adding all values. (2) `incoming` was only built for keys, so referenced-only nodes had no entry — fixed by initializing for all nodes. (3) `m not in ready` on a heap list is unreliable and could cause duplicates — fixed with an `in_ready` set for O(1) membership. (4) No cycle detection existed — fixed by checking if output length equals node count and raising ValueError if not.
